race.comment: BALLISTIC ROMEO (6) turned in an eye-catcher last start at the second run of the campaign, coming from midfield on the corner to be beaten under a length over 1720m at Geelong. Back a little in trip which isn't ideal but he is going better than most of these and should be close to peak form at the third run back. HIDDEN WITNESS (13) filled a minor placing at the first four runs this prep then was rewarded last time with a dominant win over 1400m at Hamilton. Savaged the line that day which suggests the step up to 1600m is the right move. PLUCKY ENUFF (9) lined up for only the third time and recorded a game maiden win over 1400m at Warrnambool recently. New to this trip but it looks a suitable option. Big chance again with stacks of improvement to come. FRENCH REIGN (2) is flying this prep. Has a big weight and a wide barrier but he is going too well to rule out. TEMPT THE GODS (1) disappointed at Ballarat last start but can make amends in this easier race.
